summary: Passionate HR Specialist with over 10 years of experience in recruitment, employee relations, HR systems administration, and policy compliance. Skilled in managing personnel data, training programs, and performance evaluation processes.

experience.title: HR Specialist / Horizontal Engineer
responsibilities: Managed end‑to‑end recruitment processes including head‑hunting, screening, interviewing, background checks, and onboarding.
Conducted employee orientations and processed new‑hire paperwork to ensure compliance.
Created, organized, and maintained personnel files and HR database.
Coordinated employee training and development programs.
Communicated policy changes to management and executives.
Provided administrative support for all HR functions, including filing, correspondence, and meeting preparation.

experience.title: Shipping Clerk
responsibilities: Processed customer, work, and shipping orders to determine items for movement.
Served as go‑to person for shipping process questions and issue resolution.
Trained new hires on shipping operations and reported progress to supervisors.
Gathered and verified data via SAP, producing nightly reports for the team.

experience.title: Lead / Report Specialist
responsibilities: Performed financial data analysis and implemented improved reporting tools.
Prepared presentations and developed project plans.
Automated manual data processes using macros.
Created charts and graphs for data visualization.
Drafted proposals and web analytics reports.

projects.name: Employee Evaluation Process Improvement
projects.description: Developed a new employee evaluation process that led to marked performance improvements.

projects.name: Departmental Procedures Manual
projects.description: Created a comprehensive departmental procedures manual to standardize processes and improve efficiency.
